appliance.confirm_power_off_cold: Turn it off? It stops cooling.

cards-about.light: The precision dimmer: relative drag, slide away to slow down, hold for the 1 % scale, color temperature.
cards-about.lights: A room’s lights on one card: one tap for the whole room, a round, chip or tile for each light, in its color.
cards-about.cover: Blinds, shutters, garage doors and valves: vertical position ruler, tilt, open · stop · close, favorites.
cards-about.gauge: A ring gauge for any numeric sensor with min, max and average, or centered on zero for a meter that runs both ways.
cards-about.energy-flow: Where the house’s energy comes from and where it goes, live or over a period: import and export at once, every source, lanes in their origin’s color.
cards-about.history-bars: A sensor’s last days, weeks or months as bars from its long-term statistics: the total and the average in the head, the value over each bar, and a strip of facts under them — the highest and lowest, or what it comes to in CO₂, trees, kilometers or money.
cards-about.appliance: A washer, dryer, dishwasher, oven, cooktop, fridge, coffee machine, pet feeder, fountain, litter box or small appliance on a plug, pictured: what it does, when it is ready, what it uses, its reminders.
cards-about.template: A tile whose name, line, icon, color and fill are templates, with or without an entity; a Mushroom template card pastes in.
cards-about.vehicle: A car, electric, gas, diesel or plug-in hybrid: its battery or tank, range and charge limit, when it is full, where it is, and its lock, climate, charging, trunk and windows in one row. Tesla, BMW, Renault, Volvo, Kia, Hyundai, Volkswagen, Škoda, Polestar, MG, Toyota, Ford, Mercedes-Benz, Peugeot and more.
cards-about.chart: Any time series on one chart — history, statistics, a list in an attribute (Nordpool’s prices, a solar forecast) or a weather’s forecast — past to future with now marked, thresholds in their colors and the cheapest hours found.
cards-about.swipe: Any cards, one a page, turned by a swipe or the page marks under them: side by side on a wide screen, around from the last to the first.
cards-about.schedule: A room’s heating week on Home Assistant’s own schedule helper: a timeline a day in its presets’ colors, Comfort, Eco and Away with their temperatures, its times edited, a day copied to others, the schedule on or off.
